# Sixty Service, Inc.

> Family owned and operated automotive repair shop in Richmond, Virginia (ZIP 23236, North Chesterfield area). Serving Richmond drivers for over two decades; on file with the Better Business Bureau since 2007.

## Contact
- Name: Sixty Service, Inc.
- Address: 11013 Research Ct, Richmond, VA 23236, USA
- Phone: (804) 379-9240 (call or text)
- Website: https://sixty-service-auto-repair.netlify.app/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/sixtyservice/
- Directions: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=11013+Research+Ct%2C+Richmond%2C+VA+23236

## Hours
- Monday to Friday: 7:30 AM to 5:30 PM
- Saturday: Closed
- Sunday: Closed

## Services
- Diagnostics and check-engine light
- Wheel alignment (Hofmann alignment system)
- Brakes
- Scheduled maintenance and oil service
- Virginia State Inspection
- Tire rotation
- Engine and throttle-body repair
- General repair (leaks, cooling system, electrical)

Details: https://sixty-service-auto-repair.netlify.app/services.html

## Pricing
Quoted per vehicle; there is no published price list. Call (804) 379-9240 with the vehicle year, make and model.

## Booking
- Call (804) 379-9240 during shop hours
- Request an appointment online: https://sixty-service-auto-repair.netlify.app/appointment.html (the shop follows up to confirm a drop-off time)

## FAQ
- Where is Sixty Service? 11013 Research Ct, Richmond, VA 23236, in the North Chesterfield area.
- What are the hours? Monday to Friday 7:30 AM to 5:30 PM; closed Saturday and Sunday.
- Do they do Virginia State Inspections? Yes; call ahead to check availability.
- Do they do wheel alignments? Yes, on a Hofmann alignment system.
- How much does a repair cost? It depends on the vehicle and the repair; call for a quote.
